summary: Iteration 2 regression — Counsel AI + 4-query visitor limit + 11-language dropdown + nav renames. Backend 5/5 pytest passing. Frontend smoke flows verified: nav links/routes, Logo (no Prestige tagline), /cases heading + search/filters, Counsel AI page renders + unauth Generate redirects to /login, JusticeBot chat send returns Gemini reply with disclaimer, language dropdown lists all 11 languages, admin login -> /counsel auth flow generates a complete Bail Application draft with Copy/Download buttons.

issues: GET /api/auth/me still logs 401 to browser console on every public page load. Pre-existing from iteration 1, not a functional bug.

action_items: (Carried over from iteration 1, not re-verified) Brute-force lockout still keys on request.client.host which rotates behind K8s ingress — fix to use X-Forwarded-For or email-only key. Not in scope of iteration 2 but still outstanding.
(Optional polish) Silence console 401 spam from AuthContext on public pages.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_ai.py FREE_LIMIT counter is per-session_id (not per-IP/visitor). Anyone can start a fresh session_id to reset the 4-query cap — acceptable as a soft preview limit but worth documenting.

ai.py draft_reply creates a new LlmChat per call with a random session_id; no rate-limiting on /api/draft for authed users, so a single user can spam Gemini calls. Consider per-user quota or daily cap before launch.
CounselAI.jsx — Generate Draft button has no visible 'Generating...' spinner; users only see button-disabled state during the ~20s call. Add a small loader or progress label for UX.

JusticeBot.jsx language dropdown uses radix Select with virtualized scroll. All 11 items render in DOM, but selecting items at the top of the list requires scrolling inside the popper — works for real users but can confuse automated tests. No fix required.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke-tested flows (nav, routing, counsel unauth, counsel authed draft, justicebot chat reply, cases heading)

test_credentials: Admin admin@justiceverse.in / JusticeVerse@2026 verified via login (sets httpOnly access_token/refresh_token cookies; /api/auth/me returns role=admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 deltas fully verified. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py -v` (~80s; AI draft calls take 20-30s each). For iteration 1 regression run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Outstanding bug from iteration 1 (brute-force lockout under K8s ingress) was NOT re-tested in this iteration. Frontend desktop nav requires xl viewport (>=1280px); below that, a hamburger replaces the nav.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no new bugs in iteration 2.
